title: SAM.gov Scraper – Government Bids & Federal Procurement
description: Scrape live US federal contracting opportunities from SAM.gov — solicitations, sources sought and awards — plus wage determinations, CFDA grant/loan programs and organization-only exclusion records, with no API key and no login. NAICS, set-aside, notice type and state filters, contacts, watch mode.
seoTitle: Government Contracts API, Bid Data API, Procurement Data API
seoDescription: A SAM.gov contract opportunities API: federal contracting data, government procurement data, government bid data, set-aside filters, solicitation data API, RFP data API, and wage determination API.

result.eventDescription: One normalized SAM.gov record returned to the dataset (a contract opportunity, a wage determination, a CFDA assistance-listing program, or an organization-only exclusion record, depending on data type).
